correctness.rationale: Every marked pattern has the same 3 singleton and 2b+2 doubleton symbols and no cross-bifix overlap. First-hit replacement is a bijection preserving total weight. FO layer predicates are directly definable by inversion pairs. Fibonacci prefix ratios yield an iid biased-letter limit, giving eventual occurrence with probability one. Small tests reproduce the bijection; the symbolic proof handles all b,n.

value.rationale: Exact rational saturation of a natural TOTO limit spectrum is a substantial strengthening of mere density. Uniform formulas and exact finite-n symmetries for every denominator give structural, reusable insights into FO expressibility, not a special-case numerical count.
